Post-Matric Scholarship 2026-27 Revision

The Ministry has extended the online verification window for Post-Matric Scholarships until 30 December 2026.

Applicants must upload income certificates issued after 01 April 2026. Minimum family income ceiling remains Rs 2,50,000 per annum.
